body.p: , after , , , , , , , . src/xslt_lower_group.c, src/xslt_group.c (src/xslt_group_internal.h), tests/xslt_group_test.c; hooks in src/xslt_lower.c, src/xslt_lower_control.c (xsl:for-each), src/xslt_lower_template.c (xsl:apply-templates), src/xpath_lower.c (context functions), src/evaluator.c (SORT). No IR kind, no public header.

item.p: Evaluator SORT (fixes 3.10's Proposed (a) and /'s last codepoint-only body): a descending key reverses the whole order, empty keys included (XQuery 4.0, 4.13.9: "empty greatest descending" puts () first); each key's collation is resolved once per SORT through the one resolver (sxml_function_library_find_collation, FOCH0002 otherwise, also for an empty input) and strings compare with sxml_function_library_compare_collated (glossary ). sxml_ir_sort_key gains order (an xs:string atom, "ascending" or "descending", read when evaluated: an xsl:sort order AVT) and is_composite (XSLT 4.0, 13.1.2: a key is a sequence compared item by item, the shorter first; otherwise more than one item is XPTY0004 as before). The text form prints them; the verifier checks the atom.

xsl:sort is one SORT key per xsl:sort, under for-each, apply-templates (the select value is sorted before the MAP or APPLY_TEMPLATES), perform-sort and for-each-group (sxml_xslt_lowering_call_sort). AVTs use the instruction's focus; data-type number/text convert the key (data(K) ! number(.)), a QName converts nothing; lang/case-order without collation give UCA?fallback=yes;lang=L;caseFirst=C ('s fallback, lang ignored), none the codepoint collation. Fixed invalid values are XTSE0020, computed ones XTDE0030 when evaluated; XTSE1015, XTSE1017, XTSE1040; a TRY_CATCH maps XPTY0004 to XTDE1030 and FOCH0002 to XTDE1035. Stable is always.

xsl:for-each-group: a MAP over the population makes one grouping pair per item ([item, keys] atomized, untyped as string, distinct for group-by; [item, matches] for patterns: the match expression lowered in place with the item as fixed focus, errors are no match, 6.5); the row for-each-group($pairs, $method, $collation) of src/xslt_group.c returns group arrays [current group, current grouping key]; group-by calls the XQuery group-by row () over [item, key] tuples (composite keys one member per item, padded with empty members), so keys compare exactly as XQuery's; adjacent runs and pattern boundaries are the row's. xsl:sort sorts the group arrays with the initial item as context item, the group's position and count, and the current group bound. The body is a MAP over the groups whose focus is the initial item with the MAP's position and size slots. XTSE1080, XTSE1090, XTTE1100, XTDE1110.

xsl:merge is the same parts: per merge source (for-each-item, for-each-source as doc(resolve-uri(., base)), or none) tuples [source number, item, keys...] (keys with a singleton focus), all tuples sorted stably by the first source's merge keys (SORT keys are tuple members, tuple_key_offset), runs of equal keys by the row (composite, the first key's collation), and the merge-action as the group body. XTSE2200, XTSE3190, XTSE3195, XTSE3200.

Context functions (glossary): in XSLT, fn:current-group(), current-grouping-key(), current-merge-group(), current-merge-key(), current-merge-key-array() read the variable Q{XSLT}local-name the instruction put in scope (XTSE0080 keeps the namespace out of stylesheet variables); a variable bound to NONE (pattern grouping) or none in the current function raises XTDE1061/1071/3480/3510 when evaluated. name#0 makes a closure over the value (4.0: it retains it). current-merge-group($source) is map:get of Q{XSLT} current-merge-sources. Lowering-wide XPath ASTs (short texts, match expressions) are kept until the lowering ends (sxml_xslt_lowering_keep_ast in src/xslt_lower.c, glossary ; 4.14 uses them too).

Deviations: the current group is lexical, so a template called from the body sees none (XTDE1061; the spec makes it dynamic there); split-when and merge-when are UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE; sort keys of groups are evaluated with the group's position; merge inputs are always sorted (no XTDE2220, XTDE2210), equality under the first key's collation, a composite merge key is the keys' concatenation; current-merge-group with an unknown name gives () (not XTDE3490), with () an error.

Measured with a scratch harness (each case's initial template or match="/", xml/error/string/file assertions; release of HEAD 2f0c640 plus the packet): insn/sort 74 of 82 runnable cases (before: 0, xsl:sort was UNSUPPORTED), insn/for-each-group 79 of 86 (before: 0), insn/merge 61 of 88 (before: 0); the rest need xsl:function, schemas, collections, xsl:number or accumulators, or are the deviations above (split-when, XTDE2210, XTDE2220, XTDE3490). QT4 XQ40: prod-EmptyOrderDecl 28 to 32, prod-OrderByClause 139, prod-GroupByClause 37, unchanged; ctest (debug, debug-gcc, wasm) and lint pass.
